title: A rebuilt home for making and exploring
summary:
A rebuilt playground led the day, with community listings, news updates, and smaller key and dashboard fixes alongside it.

The hello.pollinations.ai rebuild added a responsive playground for image and text generation, vision-capable model selection, interactive API examples, community creations, and themed visuals. Prompt-driven theme-generation controls remain disabled in production.

Robatika joined the Creative projects directory as a Pollinations-powered chat app. The highlights file and README also caught up with December 7 news; those edits document earlier model and API changes rather than introducing them.

Enter’s header buttons no longer wrap, and its notices have clearer placement and styling. The Hacktoberfest chat app’s fallback key was changed to a publishable key for browser requests.

highlights.title: A new place to play
highlights.text: The rebuilt site brings image and text generation, vision-capable model selection, interactive API examples, and community creations together.
